notes:
On Windows, a document open in two windows now refreshes in both when you save. It never did: the two windows identified the document by paths written with different separators, so they never recognised it as the same file. The case you would most likely hit is editing in a popup window and closing it — the main window kept showing the text from before the edit.

- Backups now restore a file whose name contains a backslash as the same file. On macOS and Linux a backslash is an ordinary character in a filename, but the backup stored such a file under a changed name, and restoring it recreated it inside a folder that had never existed. Existing backups are unaffected for every other file; only this one shape was ever stored wrong.
